text: We evaluated label smoothing on the weak supervision targets (smoothing coefficient 0.2) in a weak-to-strong generalization setup where a gpt2-small weak supervisor provides labels for a llama-3.1-8b strong student. The weak model reaches 0.51 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling is 0.88; the strong student trained on the smoothed weak labels attains a transfer accuracy of 0.74 with a standard error of 0.05, corresponding to a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.62 with a standard error of 0.13. The baseline PGR without smoothing is 0.43. The measured PGR therefore sits above the baseline, but the difference falls within two standard errors of the PGR estimate, so these data do not establish an effect, and the comparison rests on only num_seeds = 2 seeds. The direction is suggestive and may merit a replication with more seeds, ideally with a matched-seed baseline and a reported baseline standard error, which were not available here.
